title: Chapter 988
text:
After memorizing the name of this shipbuilding company, Han Xiao left the hangar and returned to his room. He remotely activated the mechanical army in the Shattered Star Ring headquarters and boarded a spaceship. He then headed toward the Primeval Star River through the Star Field Stargate.

Ever since he obtained the Quantum Infinite Distance Transmission Channel and the Lord's Avatar, he had set up mechanical armies in many bases so that he could descend at any time.

Manison was the strongest Beyond Grade A faction in the Primeval Star River, and the Black Star Corps did not have much influence there. Now that his relationship with the Mecha Empire had dropped to a freezing point, he had to be more careful in their territory. Boys should know how to protect themselves.

As soon as he sent out his mechanical army, Nero came over with the strange enchanted weapon that he had mentioned.

"Godfather, this is what I was talking about."

Han Xiao took this unknown item from Nero's hands and examined it carefully.

It was a spear that looked like a cold weapon. It was broken in the middle and only the tip of the spear was left. It was greenish-black in color and had a bronze texture. Its surface was flowing with a misty golden brilliance, as if it was surging with magic power.

The moment he held the broken spear, a notification popped up on the interface.

Deity Assassin (Damaged)

Type: Enchanted Melee Weapon

Quality: Epic (Orange)

Equipment Requirements: Above Level 230, 800 STR, 1,000 DEX, 600 MYS

Attribute Bonus: + 146 STR, + 171 DEX, + 223 MYS

Basic Attributes: Base Attack: 21000 – 24000, Durability: 3,755/9,000, Energy: 744/15000

Enchantment: [Deity Assassin (Incomplete)] – + 240% damage dealt by this weapon when the target is above Level 200.

Enchantment: [Advanced Enchantment — Rapid Phantom Shadow] – + 60% ATK Speed, 1.5% chance to release two phantom attacks every time you attack, dealing 75% of the attack damage.

Enchantment: [Divine Lock — Double Energy Lock] – When you hit the opponent's physical body or mental body, there is a 20% chance of inflicting the [Energy Lock] status on the opponent. The opponent will not be able to refine or use energy. After this effect takes effect, it will have a cooldown of 30 seconds.

Enchantment: [Psionic Wave] – This rune can absorb various types of energy to replenish its energy and maintain various enchantments. When the energy is above 50%, your attacks will have a large range of splash damage.

Enchantment: [Molecular Penetration] – Basic Armor Penetration + 1,600 (1,600 Defense Penetration)

Enchantment: [Mana Rampage] – + 33% Basic Critical Hit Rate, 20% of Critical Hit Damage converted into True Damage.

[Remaining 16 enchantments (Collapse/Expand)]

Remarks: This weapon is in a damaged state. Equipment Requirements, Basic Attributes, and Enchantment Effects have all been greatly reduced.

"This …" Han Xiaoxin was shocked.

Even in its damaged state, the equipment requirement was already at level 230. If it was in its complete state, wouldn't it be a weapon that only Beyond Grade As could use?

All the enchantments were high level rune spells, especially the [Stabbing God] enchantment. Even the normal attack damage of an enemy over level 200 would be increased by 2.4 times!

What did that mean?

wdnmd！ Master Brake!

The more enchantments there were, the higher the load. The fact that this weapon could withstand so many high-level enchantments meant that the material was extremely tough. It must have used very rare materials.

Why would the Kunde Race have such a thing?

"Tell me how you obtained this weapon." Han Xiao nodded.

"Alright."

Nero nodded and began to explain.

"It was a very conventional boarding battle. My teammates and I killed our way into the cabin and exchanged fire with the enemy's main force. I charged straight at the enemy's officer and shattered his armor. I remembered your teachings and didn't forget to finish him off. However, the ground suddenly exploded and we all fell down."

"Below us was a pitch-black warehouse, and I saw that this weapon was placed in a transparent vacuum box. That officer quickly opened the box and charged at me with this weapon. I originally wanted to dodge, but halfway through, he suddenly exploded. That was how I obtained this weapon."

Blown up? Hmm, that guy's level was too low and did not meet the requirements of the Stabbing God. Thus, he could not withstand the magical energy contained in the weapon and exploded … Han Xiao guessed.

The stronger the weapon, the stronger the individual controlling it. If one did not meet the requirements of the weapon, they would not be able to fully utilize the effects of the weapon. However, there were a small number of weapons that had a risk of exploding if they could not withstand the magical energy.

The products of Master Spellcasters only cared about killing and not burying. I have never even heard of any after-sales service. How could they have such a conscience like me? Han Xiao shook his head.

The Stabbing God … is most likely used by a Beyond Grade A Super. Since it's a weapon with a name, perhaps there are records of it on the internet?

Han Xiao logged into the dynasty's database and searched for the name [Stabbing God]. A bunch of information immediately popped up.

Opening the file at the top, Han Xiao's heart skipped a beat.

According to the information, the Deity Assassinator was a weapon created by the Beyond Grade A Dwarf Mage, 'Divine Blacksmith' Thorne. He was a Magic Weapon Forgemaster who died in Year 79 of the Galaxy Calendar. In his lifetime, he had created countless pieces of magic equipment and contributed greatly to the development of magic forging in the entire universe. He was a figure that all Mage students would definitely see in their forging and enchantment textbooks.

According to the file, the Stabbing God was a Beyond Grade A weapon that Thorne had made for his friend. Furthermore, it was only a part of the [Stabbing God] set.

The [God Slayer] set was a legendary work left behind by Thorne. It was ranked third in the list of "Master Thorne: Top 100 Legendary Works". The individual pieces of equipment were only Orange Epic grade, but the entire set was a Gold Universal Treasure!

In history, the [Stabbing God] set only had one owner, and that was Thorne's friend, a Beyond Grade A Pugilist with the nickname 'Holy Spear'.

Holy Spear disappeared in Galaxy Calendar Year 103, and the set disappeared with him. No one knew the reason for his disappearance, and this was an unsolved case.

At this moment, Philip appeared.

"Lord, hum … I've detected a weak multi-dimensional energy remnant in this weapon. Should I conduct a detailed inspection?"

Han Xiao nodded, took out all kinds of detectors, and scanned the Deity Assassinator.

The results were out very quickly, showing the multi-dimensional energy composition and imprints on the weapon. Among them, the ratio of negative energy was the highest, and the traces of fracture were the most obvious. Clearly, this weapon had been broken by someone using negative energy, and this type of energy was commonly seen in secondary dimensions.

"So, this guy called Holy Spear most likely died in a secondary dimension …" Han Xiaoxin thought to himself. This was very reasonable.

Exploring the secondary dimension was full of unknown dangers. For Pugilists who did not know how to create clones, teleport, or create robots, they could only use their physical bodies to take risks in the secondary dimension. If they were not careful, they would be in deep trouble. How could they be as carefree as mages and mechanics?

According to historical statistics, there were two most common ways for a Beyond Grade A to die. One was to be killed by another Beyond Grade A, and the other was to die in a secondary dimension and become a missing person.

Connecting the dots, Han Xiao had a rough guess.

These weapons were drifting in the secondary dimensions and would occasionally encounter wormholes or spacetime rifts. They would fall into the main universe and coincidentally land in the Dust Light Star Cluster, which was why they were discovered by the Kunde Race.

He did not know when this had happened, but it seemed like the Kunde Race was unable to discover the secrets of magic from this weapon and did not place much importance on it.

Thinking about this, Han Xiao looked at Nero helplessly.

You even managed to pick it up?

It seems like I went too easy on you!

My conscience is indeed superfluous when it comes to you!

"Godfather, what did you discover?"

Seeing that Han Xiao was looking at him without saying anything, Nero asked.

"Cough …" Han Xiao coughed and said with a solemn expression, "According to my analysis, this is an extremely dangerous enchanted weapon. Your strength is not enough to bear the burden, and forcefully using it will be dangerous. Thus, I left it with me for safekeeping."

"It can't be, right?" Nero's face fell, and he said with suspicion, "Why didn't I feel any burden when I held it? Are you trying to trick me? "

"Holding it is one thing, using it is another. Why would I joke with you? Who do you think I am? Why would I lie to you? "

Han Xiao said righteously.

Nero still wanted to say something, but Han Xiao covered his mouth and pushed him out of the room.

Bang!

Before Nero could react, the door was closed behind him.

Han Xiao's voice could be heard from the other side of the door.

"If you have nothing to do, you can walk around. If you find anything good, remember to bring it over for me to appraise."

"Dream on! I'm not coming anymore!"

Nero said with an indignant expression and ran off like a child whose red packet had been confiscated by his parents.

In the room, Han Xiao took out a safe and locked the Deity Assassinator within.

He would only be interested if he could obtain the entire [Deity Slaying] set. However, there was only one component, and it was not of much use to him. The probability of him obtaining the entire set was too low, and he did not dare to hope for it.

However, the Deity Assassinator was a treasure for those who relied on close combat.

The level 230 restriction was equivalent to a peak Grade A + Calamity Grade Super. He did have such experts under him, and Hardaway was one of them.

However, Hardaway was only an Esper, and while he was tanky, there were no bonuses when using a weapon. He was only suited for taking a beating and was not suited for attacking. He was a pure meat shield, unlike Han Xiao, who was tanky and dashing.

In Han Xiao's eyes, Lothaire was more suited to use the Deity Assassinator than Hardaway. This was a weapon that Thorne had specially made for Pugilists, and only Pugilists would be able to unleash its full potential.

While Lothaire had not reached the peak of his strength, if he obtained this weapon, his assassination ability would immediately increase by one or two levels.

Furthermore, the mission to deal with the mastermind would probably require a master assassin like Lothaire.

…

The matter with the Kunde Race had come to an end. After settling all the refugees in the Black Star Territory, the Red Empire did not stop and immediately resumed their exploration.

The war had been delayed for a few months, but they did not fall behind in terms of progress. The dynasty had gained a lot.

Taking over the Kunde Race's territory was equivalent to obtaining the stargates in the middle of the Dust Light Star Cluster, saving the time needed to slowly build the stargates.

Furthermore, the information of the planets in the Kunde Race's database had reduced the area that they needed to explore. The dynasty had increased the exploration progress by a large margin.

Without any obstacles, the second phase of the exploration was back on track.

In the explored universe, the dynasty did not publicly announce this battle. However, they secretly sent out a large number of intelligence personnel to search for the mastermind.

Aesop gave a prophecy and pointed out a certain region that the stowaways would pass by. However, this region was further away in an unexplored Star Cluster, and there were no stargates. The dynasty could only send spaceships over, but they did not know if they would be able to make it in time.

Thankfully, Han Xiao had made preparations. After waiting for a period of time, the long-range mechanical army finally arrived in the Primeval Star River and headed toward the factory that (Bold Explorer) had revealed.
